title: Scene View Deep Dive
description: Master advanced navigation, gizmos, overlays, and scene view controls.

slides.title: Beyond Basic Navigation 🧭
slides.content:
# Advanced Scene Navigation

- **Flythrough Mode**: Hold **Right Mouse Button** and move with **WASD** (hold **Shift** to go faster). This gives you a first-person view.
- **Center on Object**: Select a GameObject and press **F**. The view zooms to frame it.
- **Focus on Selection**: Double‑press **F** to lock the view onto the object and follow it while it moves.
- **Mouse Look**: While holding right-click, move the mouse to look around.

quizData.question: What key do you hold with the right mouse button to fly through the Scene view using WASD?
quizData.explanation: Holding the right mouse button and then using WASD lets you fly; no extra modifier is needed.

slides.title: Gizmos & Overlays 🎛️
slides.content:
# Controlling What You See

The Scene view toolbar has many toggles:
- **2D/3D toggle**: Switches between orthographic 2D view and perspective 3D.
- **Lighting**: Toggle scene lighting on/off to see unlit textures.
- **Audio**: Toggle to hear audio sources in the editor.
- **Effects**: Enable/disable skybox, fog, post‑processing, etc.
- **Gizmos menu**: Show/hide gizmos (camera icons, colliders, light volumes) and their size.

quizData.question: You can turn off the skybox and fog in the Scene view without affecting the Game view.
quizData.explanation: The Scene view Effects button toggles visual elements like skybox and fog only for editor preview.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Scene View Camera Settings

Click the small camera icon in the Scene view toolbar to set the Field of View or orthographic size. You can also lock the view to an object by selecting it and pressing Shift+F.

slides.title: Snap Settings
slides.content: Hold **Ctrl** while moving an object to snap it to grid increments (default 1 unit). Customize the grid in **Edit > Grid and Snap Settings**.
